_about: The repository every case is asked about (contract/security/v1/protocol.md), built fresh per case in a new git repository: a complete security pack, a declared posture, a control of the repository's own with a passing suite, a moderation hook module, and `emit.py` — an emitter that posts one OTLP/JSON span with the standard library, its first argument saying how it treats the probes (redact, leak, unmarked, nothing, broken, leak-then-fail). A case changes files, and nothing in it depends on a provider's installation.

files.emit.py:
"""The fixture's emitter: one run of telemetry, posted as OTLP/JSON with the
standard library to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Its first argument is how it
treats the probes in SECURITY_REDACTION_PROBES: redact, leak, unmarked (no
probe span), nothing (sends nothing), broken (exits 1), leak-then-fail (sends
them raw, then exits 1)."""
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.request

mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "redact"
if mode == "broken":
    sys.exit(1)
probes = json.loads(os.environ.get("SECURITY_REDACTION_PROBES") or "[]")
text = "\n".join(probe if mode.startswith("leak") else "[REDACTED]" for probe in probes)
attributes = [{"key": "input.value", "value": {"stringValue": text}}]
if mode != "unmarked":
    attributes.append({"key": "security.redaction.probe", "value": {"boolValue": True}})
span = {"traceId": "0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c", "spanId": "b7ad6b7169203331", "name": "redaction.probe",
        "kind": 1, "startTimeUnixNano": "1", "endTimeUnixNano": "2", "attributes": attributes}
body = {"resourceSpans": [{"resource": {"attributes": [
    {"key": "service.name", "value": {"stringValue": "fixture-tenant"}},
    {"key": "environment", "value": {"stringValue": os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT", "production")}}]},
    "scopeSpans": [{"scope": {"name": "fixture"}, "spans": [span]}]}]}
if mode != "nothing":
    request = urllib.request.Request(os.environ["OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/traces",
                                     data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10).read()
if mode == "leak-then-fail":
    sys.exit(1)
